elevate.move: Turn the sketch wall into a work-in-progress board: each polaroid shows the same detail drawn then inked, the inked stage revealed as its hang-tag swings, so the drawings read as a crafted series instead of thumbnails in grey frames.
Make the phone page a pocket punch list: the sticky bar carries the running hours tally and opens the tray as a bottom sheet, so hero tiles, builder and sticky bar become one product on the phone.
